method: Every final page was viewed in one of eight six-page contact sheets. Selected pages were also viewed individually at native rendered size. A preliminary 46-page build was reviewed, its TOC overflow was fixed, and the final 45-page PDF was independently rendered and reviewed again.

resolved_findings.finding: The preliminary 46-page build placed only two remaining TOC entries on page 4.
resolved_findings.resolution: The author reduced the TOC font locally and removed local paragraph spacing. The complete contents now fit legibly on final page 3, reducing the document to 45 pages.

nonblocking_observations: Page 2 is a short continuation of the scope and conventions section before the contents. It has intentional white space and no orphan heading.
The final page is partly filled with concluding verification text and references; no empty page is present.
The remaining underfull line in Theorem 4.19 on final page 33 is readable and causes no clipping or collision.
Dense source identifiers wrap within the text area. The valuation and verification tables are readable at normal PDF zoom.
scope_limit: This report checks presentation of the exact identified PDF. It is not a new mathematical proof audit, external-source authentication, or Lean compilation.
